purpose: Additive Bungie description evidence used only to establish direction for trait-associated effects when the fixture-scoped identity cache has empty free-text descriptions. No ASTRIX-authored gameplay inference.

items.name: Tempest Strike
items.officialDescription: Allows the Hunter to perform a sliding melee that launches an Arc wave along the ground, dealing significant damage and jolting enemies in its path.

items.name: Flow State
items.officialDescription: Defeating a jolted opponent causes you to become amplified. When amplified, the Hunter's dodge will recharge faster and make you more resistant to damage, and you have quicker reload times.
